display.purpose: The countdown digits. Largest element on every surface, monospaced figures, heavy weight.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels with +0.8px kerning: badges, stat labels, metadata.

motion.name: ring-fill
motion.purpose: Progress ring trim animation each tick; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: celebration
motion.purpose: Completion burst: amber ring sweep and scale. Collapses to a state change under reduced motion.

narrative.overview: An instrument for focus that rewards you for running it. Quiet and contained while a block runs, a burst of committed color and motion at completion. Color is state: each session mode owns a named role, and the entire neutral scale re-derives from the active phase hue at runtime. One rounded geometric sans carries all hierarchy through weight and scale, with the timer digits as the undisputed hero.
keyCharacteristics: Color encodes session state; neutrals are tinted per active phase hue.
One rounded geometric sans, extreme hierarchy, the timer as hero.
Flat and calm during a block, loud at completion.
Momentum (streaks, counts, progress) is the emotional payload.

rules.name: The State-Is-Color Rule
rules.body: Color is never chosen for looks alone. If the surface changes color, the session state changed. Focus, Break, Streak, and Reward each own their hue, and no role borrows another's.

rules.name: The Earned-Accent Rule
rules.body: Done Green, Charged Amber and Milestone Amber appear only at genuine momentum moments: Done Green when a block completes, Charged Amber on the streak flame and count. They are forbidden as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Hero-Digit Rule
rules.body: The timer is always the largest thing on the screen during a session. Digits are monospaced so nothing jitters as they tick.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: During an active block the surface is flat and quiet. The only motion is the ring's progress fill; the only lift is the completion celebration.

dos: Do let color encode session state; derive every color from the OKLCH triples in DesignTokens.swift, never a hand-tuned hex.
Do make the timer digits the hero: largest element on every surface, monospaced figures.
Do keep the active session surface calm and flat, then spend Done Green and motion on the completion moment only.
Do tint every neutral toward the active phase hue; never #000 or #fff.
Do honor accessibilityReduceMotion in every animated view.
Do use Canvas as the text color on any accent fill; Ink on accent fails AA.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no KPI tiles, no hero-metric template, no identical card grids.
Don't go sterile corporate: no navy-and-gray enterprise chrome.
Don't clutter the focus surface; stats and history live one layer back.
Don't spend Charged or Milestone Amber as ambient decoration.
Don't reach for gradient text, side-stripe borders, glassmorphism, or decorative shadows.
Don't use em dashes in any UI copy.
